blurb: Terravita Golf & Country Club is a private, member-owned golf course and country club located in North Scottsdale, Arizona. The club offers golf, tennis, and pickleball facilities with professional instruction available. The community is family-friendly and includes amenities such as a fitness center, pool, and nature trail.
extraNote: Guests allowed at most events and facilities for a nominal fee · One-time, non-refundable Capital Improvement Fee charged to new owners · MembersFirst and Terravita reserve right to revise website terms and policies at any time
